arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# 1. Build the cover page PDF
cover_pdf = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_pdf, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Center the title vertically-ish and the date below it
c.setFont("Times-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 30, TITLE)

c.setFont("Times-Roman", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 20, DATE_STR)

c.save()

# 2. Prepend the cover page to report.pdf
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_pdf)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("report.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)

print("Added cover page to report.pdf")
print("Title:", TITLE)
print("Date:", DATE_STR)
print("Total pages:", len(writer.pages))
